title: What Are the Good Effects of Walking?
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Many medical experts say that walking is an easy way to improve physical and mental health, support fitness and prevent disease.
sentences.zh: 许多医学专家说,步行是改善身心健康、支持身体健康和预防疾病的一种简单方式。

sentences.en: They advise that walking is a great first step toward a healthy life although other forms of exercise are also important.
sentences.zh: 他们指出,步行是走向健康生活的第一步,尽管其他形式的锻炼也很重要。

sentences.en: Good effects of walking Dr. Sarah Eby is a sports medicine physician with Mass General Brigham in the state of Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 在马萨诸塞州的Mass General Brigham, 是一个运动医学医生。

sentences.en: Eby said walking has many good effects and people do not need extra things. “You don’t need equipment and you don’t need a gym membership,” Eby noted “And the benefits are so vast .”
sentences.zh: 艾比说走路有许多好效果,人们不需要额外的东西。 “你不需要设备,也不需要体育馆会员, ” 艾比说 : “ 福利如此巨大。 ”

sentences.en: The U.S. surgeon general, a federal health officer, recommends that adults get at least two and a half hours of moderate-intensity physical activity every week.
sentences.zh: 美国外科医生,一名联邦卫生官员,建议成年人每周至少进行两个半小时的中度体力活动。

sentences.en: Walking helps meet that goal. Exercise lowers the risk of heart disease, high blood pressure, dementia, depression and many kinds of cancer.
sentences.zh: 走路有助于实现这一目标。 锻炼可以降低心脏病、高血压、痴呆症、抑郁症和多种癌症的风险。

sentences.en: Walking also helps blood sugar levels, is good for bone health, and can help people lose weight and sleep better.
sentences.zh: 步行也有助于血糖水平,有利于骨骼健康,可以帮助人们减肥和睡得更好。

sentences.en: That is what Julie Schmied said. She is a health care worker with Norton Healthcare in Kentucky, which runs the free Get Healthy Walking Club.
sentences.zh: Julie Schmied也这么说。她是肯塔基州Norton医疗保健公司的保健工作者,经营着免费的Get Health散步俱乐部。

sentences.en: Walking is also a relatively low- impact exercise that puts less pressure on joints than other exercises while strengthening the heart and lungs.
sentences.zh: 步行也是一种相对低的影响活动,比其他活动对关节的压力小,同时加强心脏和肺部。

sentences.en: James Blankenship is 68 years old. He said joining a walking club at the Louisville Zoo last year helped him recover after a heart attack and a complex triple-bypass heart operation in 2022.
sentences.zh: James Blankenship已经68岁了 他说去年加入了路易斯维尔动物园的散步俱乐部

sentences.en: “My cardiologist says I’m doing great,” he said.
sentences.zh: 他说:「我的心脏病医生说我做得很好。

sentences.en: Some say walking is not enough. Anita Gust teaches exercise science at the University of Minnesota Crookston.
sentences.zh: 有人说徒步是不够的 安妮塔·古斯特在明尼苏达·克鲁克斯顿大学教授运动科学

sentences.en: Gust said walking “is not enough for overall health and well-being” because it does not provide resistance training that builds muscle strength and endurance .
sentences.zh: Gust说,走路“对整体健康和福利来说是不够的”,因为它没有提供培养肌肉力量和耐力的抵抗训练。

sentences.en: Some health experts say that is especially important for healthy bone development in women as they age.
sentences.zh: 一些卫生专家说,这对于妇女随着年龄的增长而健康地发展骨骼尤为重要。

sentences.en: Experts recommend adding other activities at least twice weekly.
sentences.zh: 专家们建议每周至少增加两次其他活动。

sentences.en: These could include using weights, gym equipment or one’s own body for resistance exercises.
sentences.zh: 这可能包括使用重量、体操设备或自己的身体进行抵抗演习。

sentences.en: Training that improves flexibility, like yoga or stretching, can also be helpful.
sentences.zh: 提高灵活性的培训,如瑜伽或伸展,也会有所帮助。

sentences.en: How much should you walk? Many people have heard about the walking goal of 10,000 steps a day.
sentences.zh: 你该走多少路 很多人听说每天走一万步

sentences.en: This advice dates back to a 1960s marketing campaign in Japan.
sentences.zh: 这条建议可追溯到1960年代日本的市场营销运动。

sentences.en: But, experts note that this is only a guideline.
sentences.zh: 但是,专家们指出,这只是一项准则。

sentences.en: Shmied said the average American walks about 3,000 to 4,000 steps a day, and it is fine to increase that number to 10,000.
sentences.zh: 什米德说,美国人平均每天步行3000至4000步, 将这一数字增加到10,000是罚款的。

sentences.en: Setting a time goal can also be useful. Shmied suggests dividing the recommended 150 minutes per week into 30 minutes a day, or 10 minutes three times a day, for five days.
sentences.zh: 设定一个时间目标也是有益的。 Shmied建议将每周150分钟的建议分成每天30分钟,即每天3分钟,为期5天。

sentences.en: During rainy or snowy weather, people can walk in malls or on treadmills .
sentences.zh: 在雨天或雪天下,人们可以在购物中心或在跑步机上行走。

sentences.en: As they become seasoned walkers, they can speed up or walk up hills while still keeping the activity level moderate.
sentences.zh: 当他们成为老练的行尸时,他们可以加快或步行到山上,同时保持活动水平的温和。

sentences.en: “If you can talk but not sing,” Eby said, “that’s what we consider moderate-intensity exercise.” Staying with your walking program
sentences.zh: “如果你能说话但不能唱歌,”伊比说,“这就是我们所认为的温和密集运动。 ”

sentences.en: Walking with friends, including dogs, is one way to keep walking.
sentences.zh: 和包括狗在内的朋友一起走,是继续走的一种方式。

sentences.en: Walking clubs have appeared across the nation.
sentences.zh: 步行俱乐部遍布全国。

sentences.en: In 2022, 31-year-old personal trainer Brianna Joye Kohn started City Girls Who Walk with a TikTok post inviting others to walk with her in New York.
sentences.zh: 2022年,31岁的个人教练Brianna Joye Kohn开始用TikTok的海报介绍城市女孩,邀请其他人与她一起在纽约散步。

sentences.en: “We had 250 girls show up,” she said. Since then, the group has walked every Sunday for around 40 minutes, with some meeting afterward for a meal or coffee.
sentences.zh: 她说,“我们有250个女孩出现 ” 。 从那时起,这个团体每个星期天都走过大约40分钟,之后还开会吃顿饭或喝咖啡。

sentences.en: The Louisville Zoo launched its walking club in 1987.
sentences.zh: 1987年,路易斯维尔动物园成立了步行俱乐部。

sentences.en: It joined with Norton Healthcare in 2004 to expand it and now has more than 15,000 registered members.
sentences.zh: 2004年,它与诺尔顿保健局一起扩大了保健局,现已有15,000多名注册成员。

sentences.en: Every day from March 1 through October 31, people walk around and around the zoo before it officially opens.
sentences.zh: 从3月1日至10月31日,每天都有人在动物园正式开放之前四处走动。

sentences.en: Recently, Janet Rapp walked down a path through the city zoo, waving at friends and stopping briefly to greet big flightless birds called emus that she knows by name.
sentences.zh: 最近,珍妮特·拉普走过一条穿过城市动物园的道路,向朋友挥手,短暂地停下来迎接无飞机的大鸟,叫埃穆斯,她知道自己的名字。

sentences.en: The 71-year-old retiree starts each morning this way with a walking club.
sentences.zh: 71岁的退休人员 每天早上从一个步行俱乐部开始

sentences.en: “I’m obsessed,” she said. Not only does it ease her joint pain, “it just gives me energy…And then it calms me, too.”
sentences.zh: 她说 : “ 我痴迷了 ” 。 这不仅缓解了她的共同痛苦,“这只给了我能量 ”, 也使我平静下来。

sentences.en: I'm Mario Ritter, Jr. Laura Ungar reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是小Mario Ritter,Laura Ungar 为美联社报导了这个故事
